executiveSummary: Apple's iPhone Duo has sparked supply chain issues and pricing concerns, while AI/ML developments continue with Meta and Anthropic updates, and new products like HomeView and Bose's wired earbuds

takeaways.title: iPhone Duo supply chain issues
takeaways.description: Apple's iPhone Duo pre-orders are facing challenges due to potential stock shortages, with some employees advising customers to wait or pre-order to avoid disappointment (articles 1, 4, 13, 28, 29)

takeaways.title: AI/ML updates
takeaways.description: Meta has removed language allowing scraping and AI training concerns, while Anthropic has switched to OpenAI as its default model provider (articles 2, 9, 10)

takeaways.title: Pricing concerns
takeaways.description: Verizon has confirmed a $10 monthly fee for iPhone Handoff, while Apple has warned of extraordinary demand for iPhone Duo with delivery estimates slipping to 2027 (articles 17, 28, 29)

worthWatching: Apple's HomeView is a threat to online recipe writers with its simplified recipe formatting
Bose's new wired earbuds offer a simple and affordable alternative to Bluetooth earbuds
engineeringPerspective: Apple's use of liquid cooling in its new 25W MagSafe battery is an interesting development for power management
The HomeView's AI-powered recipe formatting could have implications for content delivery and optimization
